name: HEAPBLK_PREV_FREE
meaning: The block before this one is free; its size is in the u32 at header-4 (footer). Set by writeFree on the following block, cleared by CarveBlock's decrement.

name: HEAPBLK_FREE
meaning: This block is on the free list.

name: HEAPBLK_SIZE_MASK
meaning: Block size in bytes including the 8-byte header; 28 bits, so at most 256 MB.

name: HEAPBLK_ALIGN_MASK
meaning: (log2(align)-2) << 28, written only by Heap_AllocAligned; never read.
